prompt:
Implement solve(elapsedHours, extension) in solution.js returning whether privileged access remains active under company access policy. elapsedHours is a nonnegative number. extension is null or an object with approver (incident-commander or manager), addedHours (a nonnegative number), and recordedAt (hours since grant). Invalid extensions have no effect. Preserve the function interface and do not mutate extension.

Company documents (evidence):
support.md:
Standard support tickets require a first response within four hours on weekdays and twelve hours on weekends. Enterprise support tickets require a first response within two hours on weekdays and six hours on weekends. Saturday and Sunday are weekends. These targets are not resolution deadlines.

refunds.md:
The standard refund request window is thirty days after purchase. Acme annual-plan purchases are an exception with a seven-day refund request window. Acme monthly plans retain the standard thirty-day window. Refund requests on the last day of the window are eligible.

telemetry.md:
For EU users, product telemetry defaults to disabled unless consent is explicitly true. Missing or false consent is not explicit consent. Outside the EU, product telemetry defaults to enabled when consent is missing, but explicitly false consent disables telemetry.

facilities.md:
Office visitors check in at reception. Meeting rooms can be booked through the building calendar. This facilities reference does not define product behavior or customer commitments.

brand.md:
Brand presentations use clear sentences and restrained colors. The design library contains monochrome logo examples. This communications reference does not set support targets, purchase terms, or telemetry rules.

expenses.md:
Expense claims above $25 require a receipt. Claims of exactly $25 or less do not require a receipt. A lost required receipt must be replaced with a written explanation. A missing receipt that is not lost leaves the claim incomplete. A supplied receipt always satisfies the documentation requirement.

access.md:
Privileged access expires eight hours after it is granted. Only an incident commander may approve an extension, and the extension may add at most two hours. An extension must be recorded before the original access expires; recording it at the expiration instant is too late. Access is inactive at or after its expiration instant. Times are measured as hours since the grant.

renewal.md:
For Canadian accounts, automatic renewal defaults to disabled unless an administrator explicitly enables it. For Australian accounts, automatic renewal defaults to enabled unless an administrator explicitly disables it. Trial accounts in either region must never renew automatically, even with administrator approval. A null administrator setting means no explicit setting.
